title: feat: cloud worker runner, plugin build and one-time owner grant
headline: Cloud workers run only five fixed jobs through a runner that stops them at a wrong start; the owner's card yes becomes a one-time grant for one held call; the release builds into a guarded plugin; and each score gate arm carries its own global instructions into its probe.
alignment: v1.50.0 is build 23b of the v2.0 plan: K177, K216, K219, T12 with E24, K176, K175, E36, K174, K179, K230, K232, K231 and the T2 cues, K265 to K270, K266 and K275, each test seen failing first. K178 was held out after the sweep, on the owner's pick: no check inside a cloud session can anchor the sweep approval, so it stays refused there.

items.text: Recall and behaviour sessions start with `--strict-mcp-config`, so an MCP server listed in the probe project no longer joins a scored session.
The settings-change guard blocks when it cannot run: its hook entry says `onFailure: block`, the wiring check asks for it, and a check that throws holds the change and names the cause.

decisions.decision: The Q13 cue is left out
decisions.why: A cloud trial tied 5 of 5 against 5 of 5; the owner's pick (2026-11-21).

decisions.decision: A grant lifts one hold, once, for the main session only
decisions.why: A card yes names one act; a helper session has no card.

decisions.decision: The worker runner refuses outside the cloud
decisions.why: Workers run only in the cloud, by the where-work-runs rule.
New tools, a new rule and new holds reach every project.

upgrading: Run install user, then install project: the launcher, owner-proof, the start-up hook, the global instructions, the team rules, the worker brief template and the new kit tools worker.mjs, grant.mjs, owner-grant.cjs and plugin-launch.cjs change.
limits: The git pre-push hook reads its own yes record, not grants, so a granted push past the bound is still held there. A program, not a tool call, that writes a whole new grant file is not stopped: the grant hash catches slips, not an attacker. The global instructions do not reach a plugin session. On a machine whose own global instructions load beside the arm's, the score keeps its Not measured line. A cloud session is told apart from the PC by one variable it can unset. The plugin write check cannot read a path that opens with an expansion it cannot resolve, or words joined by quotes; the manifest check holds every call after such a write lands on a guard, role or hook file. With the pinned node gone, the settings-change hook refuses every change with no kit text, and the plugin hooks file lines are not yet run on Windows.
